{{Quote|Nerra, Nerra!|Numa, saying "brother" to Waxer and Boil|<ref name="Innocents of Ryloth" />}}
'''Numa''' was a [[Twi'lek]] [[Gender|female]] who lived on the [[planet]] [[Ryloth]] during the [[Clone Wars]]. As a [[youngling]], the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems|Separatists]] [[Battle of Ryloth|invaded]] her [[homeworld]], and when they came to her town of [[Nabat]], the townspeople were taken prisoner. Numa escaped and hid in the now-abandoned town until she was discovered by two [[Galactic Republic|Republic]] [[clone trooper]]s, "[[Waxer]]" and "[[Boil]]." She befriended them, and they looked after her as the Republic forces liberated the town and eventually the planet. However, when the [[Galactic Empire]] rose to power, the troopers that Numa had come to befriend and look up to turned on her people, once again imprisoning them. Numa would join the [[Free Ryloth Movement]], a rebel cell led by the infamous [[Cham Syndulla]].

==Biography==
===The Clone Wars===
====Battle of Ryloth====
{{Dialogue|Cody|Waxer, Boil, where have you two slackers been?|Boil|Sir, there is an explanation.|Waxer|We got... sidetracked.|Kenobi|I think I see what sidetracked you.|attr=Cody, Boil, Waxer, and Obi-wan Kenobi, regarding Numa|src=<ref name="Innocents of Ryloth" />}}
[[File:NumaNabat-InnocentsOfRyloth.png|thumb|left|250px|Numa grew up in the Twi'lek village of Nabat.]]
[[Reproduction|Born]] in [[26 BBY]],<ref name="Birth Date" /> Numa was a [[Gender|female]] [[Twi'lek]] who [[Homeworld|grew up]] on the [[Outer Rim Territories|Outer Rim]] [[planet]] of [[Ryloth]].<ref name="Numa Databank" /> Numa lived with her [[Numa's father|father]] and [[Numa's mother|mother]] in their humble [[Numa's home|home]], which was located in the small [[City|town]] of [[Nabat]].<ref name="Innocents of Ryloth" /> When Numa was five [[standard year]]s old, the [[The galaxy|galaxy]]-wide conflict known as the [[Clone Wars]] came to Ryloth when the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]] invaded Numa's [[homeworld]].<ref name="Storm Over Ryloth">{{TCW|Storm Over Ryloth}}</ref> The Confederacy's [[Separatist Droid Army|droid army]] invaded many population centers, subjugating the people and [[Prisoner|imprisoning]] them.<ref name="Ryloth Databank">{{Databank|ryloth|Ryloth}}</ref> Nabat was also invaded, and during the early stages of the droid occupation, Numa's home was heavily damaged and her parents were killed.<ref name="Innocents of Ryloth" /> Numa managed to survive and avoid detection from the droids by taking refuge in the town's extensive underground sewer tunnel systems.<ref name="Numa Databank" />

Some time later, the [[Galactic Republic]] launched the [[Battle of Ryloth]] in order to free Ryloth from the Confederate occupation.<ref name="Storm Over Ryloth" /> During the battle, two Republic [[clone trooper]]s from [[Jedi General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]]'s [[212th Attack Battalion|212th Battalion's]] [[Ghost Company]]—"[[Waxer]]" and "[[Boil]]"—went on a recon mission to Nabat, where they heard noise in an alleyway. The two [[trooper]]s investigated the noise, and were surprised to find a young Twi'lek girl, Numa. Young Numa was initially fearful of Waxer and Boil because she thought they were [[droid]]s; the two troopers wore full [[Phase I clone trooper armor|body armor]] and helmets. Numa even bit Boil's finger when he tried to comfort her.<ref name="Innocents of Ryloth" />

After the trio avoided the detection of a Separatist [[Ringneck recon droid|recon droid]], Waxer and Boil removed their helmets and gave Numa a [[ration bar]], explaining their good intentions, and that they were flesh and [[blood]], just like her. Upon seeing the two clones' faces, she realized they were identical, like brothers, so she pointed at each of them and said in her native language of [[Twi'leki]], "nerra," which meant brother. Waxer and Boil spoke only [[Galactic Basic Standard]] while Numa spoke only Twi'leki, so the trio could not understand one another through the spoken word. As Numa finished eating the ration bar, Waxer and Boil decided to move on and finish the recon, leaving Numa behind.<ref name="Innocents of Ryloth" />

====Returning home====
[[File:Waxer_and_Boil_comfort_Numa.png|thumb|right|300px|Numa with the clone troopers, Waxer and Boil.]]
Numa decided to follow them, staying in the shadows behind the two clones as they trekked through Nabat's neighborhoods. Waxer and Boil were fully aware that Numa was following them, but continued on their mission nonetheless. The young girl, however, soon weaved her way to stand in front of the clones, surprising them with her stealthiness, then she again called "nerra" and ran towards her half-destroyed home. Waxer and Boil followed her—though Boil thought it foolish because they were already late meeting up with [[General]] Kenobi and the 212th Legion and would be disciplined for getting distracted on their mission.<ref name="Innocents of Ryloth" />

[[File:Numa_leads_Waxer_and_Boil.png|thumb|220px|left|Numa with Waxer and Boil]]
Inside her home, Numa was overcome with grief, but was comforted when Waxer found and gave her a [[tooka doll]]—though she did begin to cry. Waxer hugged Numa and assured that they would keep her safe. Even Boil crouched down and comforted the young girl. Numa then embraced Boil, which startled him. Just then, Boil's [[comlink]] sounded: [[Clone Commander]] [[Cody|CC-2224]] "Cody" was calling. The two troopers realized they were really in trouble and hurried out of Numa's home, wondering how they were going to explain Numa to Cody and Kenobi.<ref name="Innocents of Ryloth" />

[[File:NumaWaxerBoil-OtFL.jpg|thumb|right|244x244px|Boil, Numa, and Waxer]]
However, Numa noticed the presence of several fierce Rylothian [[Diet|carnivores]] closing in on them; a [[gutkurr]] hunting pack had been set loose by the [[tactical droid]] [[TX-20]], a leader in the Confederate occupation of Ryloth. Two gutkurrs chased the trio back into Numa's home, so Waxer and Boil held the front doors to the structure shut while firing on the beasts with their [[DC-15A blaster rifle]]s. Numa, meanwhile searched for an escape route, remembering the secret passage under a trap door in the back of her former home. She got the troopers' attention, so they backed up and followed Numa down the hatch and escaped the gutkurrs. The trio made their way through the tunnels and soon emerged again above ground in a different Nabat neighborhood right near [[Jedi Master]] Kenobi and [[Commander]] Cody, Waxer and Boil's superior [[officer]]s. Numa hid behind Boil's legs until Kenobi crouched down and spoke to her in Twi'leki, inquiring as to whether Numa could lead the 212th through the tunnels to where the other Twi'leks were being held prisoner. Numa said that she could and grew very excited.<ref name="Innocents of Ryloth" />

====The clone offensive====
[[File:Epguide020.png|thumb|left|300px|Numa befriending Jedi General Obi-Wan Kenobi.]]
Shortly thereafter, the clones mounted their offensive: Numa guided Waxer, Boil, and Kenobi through the tunnels while sitting on Kenobi's shoulder to Nabat's town center where the Twi'leks were being used as living shield in order to protect the Confederacy's [[J-1 proton cannon]] that prevented the Republic from launching a full-out invasion. Kenobi put Numa down, and gave Cody and his troops on the opposite side of the square the signal, and they opened fire on the Confederate [[B1-series battle droid]]s and other defenses. As the battle raged, Kenobi used [[Obi-Wan Kenobi's second lightsaber|his lightsaber]] to free the Twi'lek prisoners from their [[stuncuffs]] and led them to the tunnels past Numa. Numa watched happily as they passed, once again free, and was found by her uncle, [[Nilim Bril]]. The two embraced, happy to see each other alive. Kenobi, Waxer, and Boil continued the fight, destroying the [[Proton cannon]]s, but the droid TX-20 in an [[Armored Assault Tank Mk I|Armored Assault Tank]] knocked the three Republic warriors to the ground with a [[laser]] blast. Numa raced from the safety of her uncle and the other Twi'leks and helped Waxer, Boil, and Kenobi to their feet. While Numa helped Kenobi up, TX-20 aimed his [[tank]]'s [[laser cannon]] at Kenobi and Numa, ready to end their lives. However, the rest of the Twi'leks were inspired by Numa's selflessness and so they took up arms against their droid oppressors, climbing TX-20's tank and ripped his mechanical body apart. Kenobi covered Numa's eyes at the violence, but she peeked out and watched anyway.<ref name="Innocents of Ryloth" />

With the proton [[cannon]]s destroyed, massive Republic [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship|''Acclamator''-class transgalactic military assault ships]] landed on the outskirts of Nabat and released their cargo—thousands of clone troopers, [[All Terrain Tactical Enforcer]]s, and [[All Terrain Reconnaissance Transport]]s. Numa and her uncle watched the landing with other Twi'leks. Waxer waved goodbye to Numa, then Boil did likewise. Numa, however, wanted a better good-bye, so she ran over and hugged Boil's leg. He told her not to be afraid because after they liberated the planet they would be back. Numa was sad that they had to go, but was glad she at least had her uncle to watch over her. She then called after them "nerra, nerra" and waved goodbye to them. Waxer and Boil asked Kenobi what "nerra" meant in Twi'leki, and he explained that it meant "brother." The two were amused and waved back to Numa and then continued<ref name="Innocents of Ryloth" /> on their march to liberate Ryloth's [[capital]] city of [[Lessu City|Lessu]] from the Confederacy.<ref name="Liberty on Ryloth">{{TCW|Liberty on Ryloth}}</ref>

[[File:TCW Waxer injured.png|thumb|A drawing of Numa on Waxer's Phase II helmet.|300x300px]]
Boil later drew an image of Numa on the side of his [[Advanced Recon Force trooper|ARF trooper]] helmet that he wore during the [[Second Battle of Geonosis]]<ref name="Landing at Point Rain">{{TCW|Landing at Point Rain}}</ref> and Wexer drew a similar image on his [[Phase II clone trooper armor|Phase II]] helmet that he wore at his death during the [[Battle of Umbara]].<ref name="Carnage of Krell">{{TCW|Carnage of Krell}}</ref>

===Age of the Empire===
====Imperial oppression====
When the [[Galactic Empire]] rose to power, Ryloth was officially declared a [[Protectorate (government system)|protectorate]] of the new regime.<ref name="LotS">''[[Lords of the Sith]]''</ref> Numa's admiration for the heroic clone troopers quickly vanished as she was shackled and imprisoned. She would be rescued by [[Cham Syndulla]]'s [[Free Ryloth Movement]] and soon became an agent of the cause. Her aptitude with [[grenade]]s and other explosives led to a meteoric rise through the Movement's ranks, with Syndulla personally mentoring her.<ref name="Dawn">''[[Dawn of Rebellion]]''</ref>

====Aiding the rebellion====
[[File:Ryloth_rebels.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Numa (far right) with Glie and Cham.]]
Three years before the [[Battle of Yavin]], Numa had become one of Syndulla's best fighters in the Free Ryloth Movement. She and [[Gobi Glie]] accompanied Cham on a mission to rendezvous with the [[Spectres]], another rebel cell that was led by Cham's daughter [[Hera Syndulla]]. After docking their [[Nu-class attack/transport shuttle|''Nu''-class shuttle]] with the rebel ship ''[[Ghost]]'', Numa and her comrades attended a briefing with the Spectres to discuss a plan to take out an Imperial [[Quasar Fire-class cruiser-carrier|''Quasar Fire''-class cruiser-carrier]] orbiting Ryloth. Since the fighter carrier housed [[TIE/sa tactical bomber|TIE/sa bombers]] that devastated Ryloth, Cham advocated destroying the ship to demonstrate the strength of the Ryloth rebels.<ref name="Homecoming" />

However, Hera disagreed with her father's plan and advocated stealing the cruiser-carrier for the rebellion. After a heated discussion, Cham reluctantly conceded to Hera's plan. In secret, Cham still intended to destroy the Imperial cruiser-carrier and instructed Numa and Glie to bring a bag of [[detonator]]s. During the journey to Ryloth, Numa and her Twi'lek comrades pretended to befriend the Spectres. After landing a stolen TIE bomber in the Imperial cruiser carrier, the Ryloth rebels put their plan into action. Under Cham's orders, Numa and Glie stunned the rebels [[Ezra Bridger]], [[Sabine Wren]], [[Kanan Jarrus]], and [[Garazeb Orrelios]] while Cham dealt with Hera and her [[astromech droid]] [[C1-10P|Chopper]].<ref name="Homecoming" />

After exiting their TIE bomber, Numa and her companions dispatched a squad of [[stormtrooper]]s that had been sent to the hangar bay. While Cham proceeded to disable the ship's [[hyperdrive]], Numa and Glie headed with their detonators to the munitions rack. Shortly later, they were caught up in a gun battle with stormtroopers. Two of the Spectres, Wren and Orrelios, managed to overpower Numa and Glie by using a rigged [[MSE-6 series repair droid|mouse droid]] to [[stun]] them. The two rebels then secured their Twi'lek prisoners while the other four rebels convinced Cham to abandon his plan to destroy the Imperial cruiser-carrier.<ref name="Homecoming" />

While Hera reasoned with her father, Wren played the recording to Numa and Glie in an effort to convince them to join forces. After several Imperial reinforcements and TIE bombers attempted to reclaim the cruiser-carrier, Numa and Glie joined forces with Wren and Orrelios in repelling the Imperial forces. In the end, the two rebel forces managed to hijack the Imperial ship and escape the Ryloth system. While leaving, they destroyed an [[Arquitens-class command cruiser|''Arquitens''-class command cruiser]], which boosted the morale of the Ryloth rebels. Having established a working relationship with the rebellion, Numa and her Twi'lek comrades then departed on their shuttle back to Ryloth.<ref name="Homecoming" />

====Recovering the Kalikori====
[[File:Lothal_and_Ryloth_rebels_join_forces.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Numa, Cham, and the Spectres in the canyon]]
Two years before the Battle of Yavin, a new Imperial commander named [[Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo|Thrawn]] took charge of the Imperial counterinsurgency campaign against the Free Ryloth movement. By studying Twi'lek culture, art, philosophy, and history, Thrawn was able to devise tactics which led to the capture of [[Tann Province]]; the home of [[Syndulla clan]]. While Numa and Cham were riding their [[blurrg]] mounts to rendezvous with Hera's crew and Glie, they were pursued by several Imperial [[scout trooper]]s and an [[K79-S80 Imperial Troop Transport|Imperial Troop Transport]]. Numa and Cham managed to fight off their pursuers long enough for the ''Ghost'' to come and pick them up.<ref name="Hera's Heroes">{{Rebels|Hera's Heroes}}</ref>

Once aboard, Numa, along with Cham and Orrelios, knocked out a [[Unidentified scout trooper (Ryloth)|scout trooper]] who had climbed aboard the vessel. Later, Numa attended a briefing where Cham outlined the recent events to Hera and her crew. When Bridger asked what a [[Kalikori]] was, Numa explained that it was a Twi'lek heirloom that was valuable to Hera's family. Numa, Glie, Cham, and the other rebels volunteered to take part in a mission to recover Hera's [[Syndulla Kalikori|Kalikori]] from the [[Syndulla residence]], which had become the new Imperial headquarters.<ref name="Hera's Heroes" />

For the mission, Numa and the other rebels staged a diversionary attack on an Imperial patrol in a nearby canyon while Hera, Bridger, and Chopper went to recover the Kalikori. After destroying a troop transport and an [[All Terrain Defense Pod|AT-DP walker]], the rebels fled into the wilderness but were pursued by a second walker. Following a gun battle, Thrawn's second-in-command, [[Captain]] [[Slavin]], contacted the two rebel cells to inform them that he had captured Hera and Bridger. He threatened to execute the prisoners if Cham failed to surrender by dawn.<ref name="Hera's Heroes" />

After Cham agreed to surrender in return for his daughter and Bridger's lives, Numa and the other rebels traveled to the Syndulla residence in the ''Ghost''. Cham was about to proceed with the exchange when Hera ordered Chopper to detonate several explosives placed throughout the residence. This knocked out the Imperial forces and allowed all of the rebels to escape. However, they failed to recover the Kalikori, which was retained by Thrawn to add to his art collection. Numa and Glie later mingled with the other Spectres while Hera reaffirmed her love for her father, Jarrus, and her crew.<ref name="Hera's Heroes" />

==Personality and traits==
[[File:NumaWorried-SWE.png|thumb|right|200px|Numa was wary of new things.]]
Numa was a female Twi'lek with turquoise skin and brown [[eye]]s. As a child, she was feisty, being able to remain undetected in occupied Nabat even though the rest of its population had been either killed or rounded up by the Separatist military. She was afraid of Waxer and Boil when she encountered them, Waxer believing that she thought the two clones' armor meant they were droids. However, she would come to trust and admire the clones as they helped to liberate Nabat.<ref name="Innocents of Ryloth" /> After the rise of the Empire, Numa's distrust for outsiders grew, feeling a deep sense of betrayal towards the Empire and the soldiers she once admired. Much of her life was defined by war, and this caused Numa to have a cold and aloof personality, rarely speaking unless necessary.<ref name="Dawn" />

During her childhood, she was only able to speak her native language of Twi'leki,<ref name="Innocents of Ryloth" /> but she was fluent in Galactic Basic Standard by the time of her adulthood.<ref name="Homecoming" />

==Skills and abilities==
Even as a child, Numa was able to avoid the battle droid forces which occupied her home city, even though the rest of Nabat's population had been killed or rounded up. She also possessed knowledge of its expansive sewer system, which allowed General Kenobi to stage an attack against the occupiers.<ref name="Innocents of Ryloth" />

As an adult, Cham Syndulla considered Numa one of the most skilled warriors in the Free Ryloth Movement,<ref name="Homecoming" /> asserting herself as a dedicated agent. She was capable with a [[blaster pistol]] and had expertise with many types of grenades, including [[armor-piercing grenade]]s and [[Fragmentation grenade|frag grenades]].<ref name="Dawn" />

==Equipment==
As a child, Numa wore a brown sleeveless dress, brown headdress and brown shoes.<ref name="Innocents of Ryloth" /> When she grew up and became a freedom fighter, Numa wore a tight-fitting black shirt and light brown pants, as well as a beige and black headdress. She wore white-and-orange armor pieces on her left arm, with "BOIL" written on one piece in [[Aurebesh]]<ref name="Homecoming" /> in reference to her rescuers.<ref name="Homecoming EG">{{SW|url=series/star-wars-rebels/homecoming-episode-guide|text="Homecoming" Episode Guide | Star Wars Rebels}}</ref> She also has a faded tooka illustration on her tunic. She wielded a [[DC-17 repeater hand blaster|DC-17 hand blaster]].<ref name="Homecoming" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|These soldiers don't get it until they run into the orphan refugee girl who has somehow managed to survive in the bombed-out city. At first they don't want anything to do with her, but then they begin to realize how importnat her life is and the lives of her fellow Twi'leks.|[[Henry Gilroy]], writer of "Innocents of Ryloth"|<ref name="Art of TCW">''[[The Art of Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]''</ref>}}
Numa first appeared in the episode "[[Innocents of Ryloth]]" from the [[The Clone Wars: Season One|first season]] of the animated series ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'',<ref name="Innocents of Ryloth" /> released on [[March 6]], [[2009]].<ref name="Innocents EG old">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode020.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Innocents of Ryloth}}</ref> She voiced by voice actress [[Catherine Taber]],<ref name="Innocents of Ryloth" /> who also voiced [[Padmé Amidala Naberrie|Padmé Amidala]] in the series.<ref name="BSV">{{TCW|Blue Shadow Virus (episode)}}</ref> Early concept art of Numa was done by [[Kilian Plunkett]]<ref name="Art of TCW" /> and her model was designed by [[Jackson Sze]] and finished on a [[January 25]].<ref name="Tumblr">{{Tumblr|subdomain=starwars|name=''Star Wars''|url=post/133079547983/artist-of-the-week-jackson-sze|text=Artist of the Week - Jackson Sze|archivedate=133079547983}}</ref> Pieces of lightning concept art featuring her was done by [[Matt Gaser]].<ref name="Art of TCW" />

Numa later re-appeared as an adult in the ''[[Star Wars Rebels]]'' [[Star Wars Rebels Season Three|Season Three]] episode "[[Homecoming]]",<ref name="Homecoming" /> released on [[February 17]], [[2016]],<ref name="Homecoming release">{{WebCite|url=http://affiliate.zap2it.com/tv/star-wars-rebels/EP018796240045?aid=dxd|text=Star Wars Rebels: Homecoming|work=Disney XD Official Schedule|archivedate=20161224185649}}</ref> where she was again voiced by Taber.<ref name="Homecoming" /> Her model for the episode was designed by [[Chris Glenn]] and finished on [[January 27]], [[2015]].<ref name="Homecoming EG" />

In a tweet in October of that year, Taber opined that, in her mind, Numa was a descendant of [[Star Wars Legends|Legends]] characters [[Mission Vao]] and [[Vette]], two other Twi'lek characters whom she had voiced in the past.<ref name="Twitter">{{Twitter|cattaber|status/790741579224887296|[[Catherine Taber]]|date=2016-10-24|quote=I believe Vette, Mission & Numa from #CloneWars & #StarWarsRebels are all related (they DO have similar voices(; ) #StarWars #Twileks #SWTOR|archivefile=File:Catherine Taber-Numa Tweet.png}}</ref>
